tagline.zh: 清空这片星域，再击落守在尽头的机甲。
tagline.en: Clear the sector, then bring down the mech that guards it.

desc.en: Finish a run, win or lose.
Destroy every enemy and the boss.

how.zh: 武器自动开火，你只管走位。击落全部敌机和首领即通关；生命归零或倒计时结束，本局结束。按住加速时移动更快，击落得分翻倍。护盾抵消下一次伤害，用过后需要冷却。
how.en: The weapon fires by itself; you fly. Destroy every enemy and the boss to clear. The run ends when your HP reaches zero or the countdown runs out. Holding boost makes you faster and doubles the score of each kill. The shield absorbs the next hit and then needs to recharge.

note.zh: 每高一级，敌机的速度和耐久各提高四分之一个基准值。首领不受影响。
note.en: Each level adds a quarter of the base value to enemy speed and durability. The boss is not affected.

screenshot_alt.zh: 《星环巡航》局内截图：蓝色三角形是玩家，向右发射一排黄色子弹；橙色方块是敌机，红色菱形和粉色箭头是敌方弹幕；上方有得分、生命条、倒计时和首领血条。
screenshot_alt.en: Orbit Patrol in game: the blue triangle is the player, firing a row of yellow bullets to the right; orange squares are enemies, red diamonds and pink arrows are enemy fire; the score, the HP bar, the countdown and the boss HP bar are along the top.

art_alt.zh: 《星环巡航》主视觉：一架战机拖着橙色尾焰飞向星云中的巨型机甲。
art_alt.en: Orbit Patrol key art: a fighter with orange engine trails flies toward a giant mech in a nebula.
